sloka: धन्यम् यशस्यम् आयुष्यम् पुत्र्यम् स्वर्ग्यम् अथ अपि च ।यः श्रावयति विप्रेषु क्षत्रियेषु इतेरेषु च ॥१-४४-२१॥
transliteration: dhanyam yaśasyam āyuṣyam putryam svargyam atha api ca ।yaḥ śrāvayati vipreṣu kṣatriyeṣu itereṣu ca ॥1-44-21॥

translations.english: He will be blessed with fame, longevity, progeny and (after death) heaven brahmins One who recites this story of Ganga to the kshatriyas and others, the gods and his forefathers would be pleased with him.
translations.hindi: महाराज भगीरथ के ये वाक्य सुन, सर्वलोकपितामह, ब्रह्मा यह मधुर एवं शुभ वाणी बोले
